ShortDescription.Value: Flips building driveways for left-hand cities, keeping traffic flow smooth and aligned without crossovers.

Publish.LongDescription:
# Smooth Left-Hand Traffic Smooth Left-Hand Traffic flips building internal roads and driveways for **LHT** cities so entrances and exits match traffic direction more cleanly.
It includes a toolbar toggle that lets you control inversion for **each asset and each upgrade separately**, and your choice is saved.
### Important notes - Changing the setting affects **all already-placed instances** of that asset or upgrade. - Switching the setting may cause temporary **pathfinding conflicts**; replacing the affected building or upgrade usually fixes it. - The mod currently **does not support having both left-hand and right-hand versions of the same asset at the same time**. - The mod only affects **LHT saves**. RHT saves are unaffected.
Publish.ChangeLog: - Fixed an issue where a game assembly could be included in the published mod package.
